entries.body: Rules so far: API compute_invoice(lines,customer)->dict of 2dp strs subtotal/discount/tax/total; format_money stub. S1: round line half-up before sum, discount=r2(sub*rate) (rate 0), tax=r2((sub-disc)*0.10), total=sub-disc+tax. S2: ValueError on empty lines/qty not positive int/neg price; bulk qty>=200 x0.88, >=50 x0.95. Implemented in invoice/core.py (stage2 done).
